"""One-off, offline baseline/implementation comparison; no production data writes."""
import gc
import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import types
import wave

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
BASE = "22a5868d46e89b51ccc0d293d95b5bf226d95cae"
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "forseti-harness"))
os.environ["HF_HUB_OFFLINE"] = "1"
os.environ["HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY"] = "1"
os.environ["TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE"] = "1"


def module_at_base(relative, name):
    data = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{BASE}:{relative}"], cwd=ROOT)
    module = types.ModuleType(name)
    module.__file__ = str(ROOT / relative)
    sys.modules[name] = module
    exec(compile(data, module.__file__, "exec"), module.__dict__)
    return module


def digest(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()


def transcript_probe():
    from cleaning import transcript_product_extractor as after
    before = module_at_base("forseti-harness/cleaning/transcript_product_extractor.py", "baseline_extractor")
    cues = [{"start_ms": i * 1000, "end_ms": (i + 1) * 1000,
             "text": f"Dior Sauvage Elixir sample {i} is eight out of ten."} for i in range(5000)]
    items = [{"brand": "Dior", "line": "Sauvage Elixir", "concentration": "elixir", "stance_vote": 0.8,
              "extractor_confidence": 0.9, "source_pointer": f"sample {i * 49} is eight out of ten",
              "stated_rating": {"value": 8, "scale_max": 10, "source_pointer": "eight out of ten"}} for i in range(100)]
    items.extend([{"source_pointer": "fabricated quote"}, None])
    payload = json.dumps(items)
    results = {"before": [], "after": []}
    output_hashes = set()
    counts = None
    for repeat in range(5):
        for label, mod in ([('before', before), ('after', after)] if repeat % 2 == 0 else [('after', after), ('before', before)]):
            transcript = mod.TranscriptInput(video_id="dogfood", transcript_anchor="DOGFOOD", transcript_source="caption", cues=cues)
            start = time.perf_counter()
            out = mod.parse_mentions(payload, transcript, model="offline-fixed-response")
            elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
            serial = {"mentions": [m.model_dump(mode="json") for m in out.mentions], "rejected": out.rejected}
            assert len(out.mentions) == 100 and len(out.rejected) == 2
            assert all(m.stated_rating.value == 8 for m in out.mentions)
            output_hashes.add(digest(serial))
            results[label].append(elapsed)
            counts = {"accepted": len(out.mentions), "rejected": len(out.rejected)}
            print(f"transcript repeat={repeat + 1} arm={label} seconds={elapsed:.4f}", flush=True)
    assert len(output_hashes) == 1, "Full serialized extraction results differ"
    return {"seconds": results, "median_seconds": {k: statistics.median(v) for k, v in results.items()},
            "output_sha256": next(iter(output_hashes)), "counts": counts, "cues": len(cues),
            "input_sha256": digest({"cues": cues, "model_response": payload})}


def asr_probe():
    import faster_whisper
    from source_capture.transcript import audio_asr as after
    before = module_at_base("forseti-harness/source_capture/transcript/audio_asr.py", "baseline_audio_asr")
    silence = HERE / "silence.wav"
    with wave.open(str(silence), "wb") as stream:
        stream.setnchannels(1)
        stream.setsampwidth(2)
        stream.setframerate(16000)
        stream.writeframes(b"\0\0" * 32000)
    clips = [HERE / "speech.wav", silence, HERE / "speech.wav"]
    assert clips[0].stat().st_size > 1000
    factory = faster_whisper.WhisperModel
    timings = {"before": [], "after": []}
    constructions = {"before": [], "after": []}
    output_hashes = set()
    final_outputs = None
    for repeat in range(3):
        for label, mod in ([('before', before), ('after', after)] if repeat % 2 == 0 else [('after', after), ('before', before)]):
            gc.collect()
            loads = []
            def counted_model(*args, **kwargs):
                loads.append(1)
                return factory(*args, **kwargs)
            faster_whisper.WhisperModel = counted_model
            start = time.perf_counter()
            try:
                if label == "after":
                    with mod.AudioTranscriber(model_name="small", compute_type="int8") as session:
                        outputs = []
                        for i, clip in enumerate(clips):
                            outputs.append(session(str(clip)))
                            print(f"ASR repeat={repeat + 1} arm={label} clip={i + 1} posture={outputs[-1][0]}", flush=True)
                else:
                    outputs = []
                    for i, clip in enumerate(clips):
                        outputs.append(mod.transcribe_audio(str(clip), model_name="small", compute_type="int8"))
                        print(f"ASR repeat={repeat + 1} arm={label} clip={i + 1} posture={outputs[-1][0]}", flush=True)
            finally:
                faster_whisper.WhisperModel = factory
            elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
            assert [v[0] for v in outputs] == ["transcribed", "no_speech", "transcribed"], outputs
            assert outputs[0][1] and outputs[2][1]
            assert len(loads) == (3 if label == "before" else 1)
            timings[label].append(elapsed)
            constructions[label].append(len(loads))
            output_hashes.add(digest(outputs))
            final_outputs = outputs
            print(f"ASR repeat={repeat + 1} arm={label} seconds={elapsed:.4f} loads={len(loads)}", flush=True)
    assert len(output_hashes) == 1, "Real ASR cues, postures, or metadata differ"
    return {"seconds": timings, "median_seconds": {k: statistics.median(v) for k, v in timings.items()},
            "constructor_counts": constructions, "output_sha256": next(iter(output_hashes)), "outputs": final_outputs,
            "model": "small", "compute_type": "int8", "faster_whisper_version": faster_whisper.__version__,
            "clips": [{"name": p.name, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in clips]}


if __name__ == "__main__":
    mode = sys.argv[1]
    print(f"Starting {mode} offline paired comparison", flush=True)
    result = {"base": BASE, "python": sys.version, "mode": mode,
              "result": transcript_probe() if mode == "transcript" else asr_probe()}
    path = HERE / f"{mode}_comparison.json"
    path.write_text(json.dumps(result, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps(result["result"]["median_seconds"]), flush=True)
    print(f"verified_output={path}", flush=True)

"""Offline diagnostic only: isolated AB/BA ASR workers; no production writes."""
from __future__ import annotations

import hashlib
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import types

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[2]
BASE = "22a5868d46e89b51ccc0d293d95b5bf226d95cae"
SOURCE = "forseti-harness/source_capture/transcript/audio_asr.py"
OUTPUT = HERE / "asr_isolated_comparison.json"


def digest(value):
    return hashlib.sha256(json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, separators=(",", ":")).encode()).hexdigest()


def clock():
    return time.perf_counter(), time.process_time()


def elapsed(start):
    return {"wall_seconds": time.perf_counter() - start[0],
            "cpu_seconds": time.process_time() - start[1]}


def worker(arm):
    os.environ["HF_HUB_OFFLINE"] = "1"
    os.environ["HF_HUB_DISABLE_TELEMETRY"] = "1"
    os.environ["TRANSFORMERS_OFFLINE"] = "1"
    sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "forseti-harness"))
    import faster_whisper

    if arm == "before":
        read = subprocess.run(["git", "show", f"{BASE}:{SOURCE}"], cwd=ROOT,
                              capture_output=True, timeout=10, check=True)
        source = read.stdout
        module = types.ModuleType("isolated_baseline_audio_asr")
        module.__file__ = str(ROOT / SOURCE)
        sys.modules[module.__name__] = module
        exec(compile(source, module.__file__, "exec"), module.__dict__)
    else:
        from source_capture.transcript import audio_asr as module
        source = (ROOT / SOURCE).read_bytes()
    prior = json.loads((HERE / "asr_comparison.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    expected_hash = prior["result"]["output_sha256"]
    clips = [HERE / "speech.wav", HERE / "silence.wav", HERE / "speech.wav"]
    clip_inputs = [{"name": p.name, "sha256": hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest()} for p in clips]
    assert clip_inputs == prior["result"]["clips"], "Dogfood audio bytes changed"
    model_class = faster_whisper.WhisperModel
    original_init = model_class.__init__
    original_transcribe = model_class.transcribe
    phases = []
    current_clip = 0

    def timed_init(self, *args, **kwargs):
        started = clock()
        try:
            original_init(self, *args, **kwargs)
        finally:
            phases.append({"phase": "constructor", "clip": current_clip, **elapsed(started)})

    def timed_transcribe(self, *args, **kwargs):
        clip_index = current_clip
        started = clock()
        try:
            segments, info = original_transcribe(self, *args, **kwargs)
        finally:
            phases.append({"phase": "transcribe_sync", "clip": clip_index, **elapsed(started)})

        def timed_segments():
            started = clock()
            try:
                yield from segments
            finally:
                phases.append({"phase": "generator_exhaustion", "clip": clip_index, **elapsed(started)})

        # No model instance is retained by instrumentation. The original generator
        # retains only its normal runtime references, and is exhausted by the caller.
        return timed_segments(), info

    model_class.__init__ = timed_init
    model_class.transcribe = timed_transcribe
    outputs = []
    clip_timings = []
    batch_start = clock()
    try:
        if arm == "after":
            with module.AudioTranscriber(model_name="small", compute_type="int8") as session:
                for current_clip, path in enumerate(clips, 1):
                    started = clock()
                    outputs.append(session(str(path)))
                    clip_timings.append({"clip": current_clip, **elapsed(started)})
        else:
            for current_clip, path in enumerate(clips, 1):
                started = clock()
                outputs.append(module.transcribe_audio(str(path), model_name="small", compute_type="int8"))
                clip_timings.append({"clip": current_clip, **elapsed(started)})
        batch = elapsed(batch_start)
    finally:
        model_class.__init__ = original_init
        model_class.transcribe = original_transcribe
    assert [v[0] for v in outputs] == ["transcribed", "no_speech", "transcribed"]
    assert outputs[0][1] and outputs[2][1]
    assert digest(outputs) == expected_hash, "Serialized outputs differ from prior dogfood"
    constructions = sum(p["phase"] == "constructor" for p in phases)
    assert constructions == (3 if arm == "before" else 1)
    phase_totals = {
        phase: {metric: sum(p[metric] for p in phases if p["phase"] == phase)
                for metric in ("wall_seconds", "cpu_seconds")}
        for phase in ("constructor", "transcribe_sync", "generator_exhaustion")
    }
    return {"status": "passed", "arm": arm, "pid": os.getpid(), "batch": batch,
            "clips": clip_timings, "phases": phases, "phase_totals": phase_totals,
            "constructor_count": constructions, "output_sha256": expected_hash,
            "source_sha256_lf": hashlib.sha256(source.replace(b"\r\n", b"\n")).hexdigest(),
            "model": "small", "compute_type": "int8", "faster_whisper_version": faster_whisper.__version__}


def main():
    report = {"status": "running", "base": BASE, "order": ["before", "after", "after", "before"],
              "worker_timeout_seconds": 60, "timing_scope": "batch includes model release; imports/process launch excluded; CPU is process-wide across native threads",
              "runs": []}
    for index, arm in enumerate(report["order"], 1):
        print(f"Isolated ASR worker {index}/4 arm={arm}; limit=60s", flush=True)
        launch = clock()
        try:
            result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-u", str(Path(__file__).resolve()), "--worker", arm],
                                    cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
            outer = elapsed(launch)
            if result.returncode != 0:
                raise RuntimeError(f"worker exit={result.returncode}; stdout={result.stdout[-1000:]}; stderr={result.stderr[-3000:]}")
            row = json.loads(result.stdout)
            assert row["status"] == "passed"
            row["worker_launch_and_run_wall_seconds"] = outer["wall_seconds"]
            row["stderr_tail"] = result.stderr[-1000:]
            report["runs"].append(row)
        except (subprocess.TimeoutExpired, RuntimeError, ValueError, AssertionError) as exc:
            report["status"] = "failed"
            report["failure"] = {"arm": arm, "worker_index": index, "error": f"{type(exc).__name__}: {exc}"}
            OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
            print(json.dumps(report["failure"]), flush=True)
            return 1
        OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
        print(f"Worker {index} passed; batch={row['batch']}", flush=True)
    report["medians"] = {}
    for arm in ("before", "after"):
        runs = [r for r in report["runs"] if r["arm"] == arm]
        report["medians"][arm] = {
            "batch": {metric: statistics.median(r["batch"][metric] for r in runs)
                      for metric in ("wall_seconds", "cpu_seconds")},
            "phase_totals": {phase: {metric: statistics.median(r["phase_totals"][phase][metric] for r in runs)
                                      for metric in ("wall_seconds", "cpu_seconds")}
                             for phase in ("constructor", "transcribe_sync", "generator_exhaustion")},
        }
    report["status"] = "passed"
    OUTPUT.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({"status": report["status"], "medians": report["medians"], "output": str(OUTPUT)}), flush=True)
    return 0


if __name__ == "__main__":
    if len(sys.argv) == 3 and sys.argv[1] == "--worker":
        assert sys.argv[2] in {"before", "after"}
        print(json.dumps(worker(sys.argv[2])), flush=True)
    else:
        raise SystemExit(main())

import hashlib
import json
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import time

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[2]
BASE = "22a5868d46e89b51ccc0d293d95b5bf226d95cae"


if len(sys.argv) > 1 and sys.argv[1] == "worker":
    name, arm = sys.argv[2:]
    target = ROOT / ".agents/hooks" / name
    source = HERE / f"{arm}_{name}.source"
    sys.path.insert(0, str(target.parent))
    sys.argv = [str(target), "--strict"]
    code = compile(source.read_bytes(), str(target), "exec")
    globals()["__file__"] = str(target)
    exec(code, globals())
else:
    report = {"base": BASE, "python": sys.version, "same_working_tree": str(ROOT), "checks": {}}
    for name in ["check_map_links.py", "check_silver_lane_registry.py"]:
        relative = f".agents/hooks/{name}"
        before = subprocess.check_output(["git", "show", f"{BASE}:{relative}"], cwd=ROOT)
        after = (ROOT / relative).read_bytes()
        for arm, data in [("before", before), ("after", after)]:
            (HERE / f"{arm}_{name}.source").write_bytes(data)
        records = {"before": [], "after": []}
        outputs = set()
        for repeat in range(5):
            for arm in (["before", "after"] if repeat % 2 == 0 else ["after", "before"]):
                start = time.perf_counter()
                result = subprocess.run([sys.executable, str(__file__), "worker", name, arm], cwd=ROOT,
                                        capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=60)
                elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
                records[arm].append({"seconds": elapsed, "returncode": result.returncode,
                                     "stdout": result.stdout, "stderr": result.stderr})
                outputs.add((result.returncode, result.stdout, result.stderr))
                print(f"{name} repeat={repeat + 1} arm={arm} seconds={elapsed:.4f} rc={result.returncode}", flush=True)
                assert result.returncode == 0, result.stdout + result.stderr
        assert len(outputs) == 1, f"{name}: observable checker outputs differ"
        report["checks"][name] = {"runs": records,
            "median_seconds": {k: statistics.median(r["seconds"] for r in v) for k, v in records.items()},
            "source_sha256": {"before": hashlib.sha256(before).hexdigest(), "after": hashlib.sha256(after).hexdigest()}}
        (HERE / "checker_comparison.json").write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2), encoding="utf-8")
    print(json.dumps({k: v["median_seconds"] for k, v in report["checks"].items()}), flush=True)

"""Same-tree baseline/current discovery-only dogfood, no production writes."""
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import statistics
import subprocess
import sys
import time
import types
from unittest.mock import patch

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[3]
OUT = Path(__file__).with_suffix('.json')
REL = '.agents/hooks/check_silver_lane_registry.py'
BASE = '22a5868d46e89b51ccc0d293d95b5bf226d95cae'
argv = ['git', 'show', BASE + ':' + REL]
proc = subprocess.run(argv, cwd=ROOT, capture_output=True, timeout=20)
assert proc.returncode == 0, proc.stderr.decode('utf-8', errors='replace')
baseline_bytes = proc.stdout
current_bytes = (ROOT / REL).read_bytes()
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / '.agents/hooks'))

def load_source(name, data):
    module = types.ModuleType(name)
    module.__file__ = str(ROOT / REL)
    sys.modules[name] = module
    exec(compile(data, module.__file__, 'exec'), module.__dict__)
    return module

baseline = load_source('silver_discovery_baseline', baseline_bytes)
current = load_source('silver_discovery_current', current_bytes)
assert baseline._PRODUCER_DISCOVERY_EXCLUDED_DIRS == current._PRODUCER_DISCOVERY_EXCLUDED_DIRS
excluded = current._PRODUCER_DISCOVERY_EXCLUDED_DIRS
real_scandir = os.scandir
records = []
expected = None
for pair in range(5):
    order = [('baseline', baseline), ('current', current)]
    if pair % 2:
        order.reverse()
    for label, module in order:
        scans = []
        def counted_scandir(path):
            scans.append(Path(path))
            return real_scandir(path)
        start = time.perf_counter()
        with patch('os.scandir', counted_scandir):
            discovered = module._producer_files(ROOT)
        elapsed = time.perf_counter() - start
        membership = [p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() for p in discovered]
        assert discovered == sorted(discovered), label
        if expected is None:
            expected = membership
        assert membership == expected, f'Membership changed: {label} pair {pair}'
        excluded_scans = [p for p in scans if set(p.relative_to(ROOT / 'forseti-harness').parts).intersection(excluded)]
        record = dict(pair=pair + 1, kind=label, elapsed_seconds=elapsed,
                      membership_count=len(membership), scandir_calls=len(scans),
                      unique_scanned_directories=len(set(scans)),
                      excluded_subtree_scandir_calls=len(excluded_scans),
                      unique_excluded_directories=len(set(excluded_scans)),
                      excluded_directory_examples=sorted(p.relative_to(ROOT).as_posix() for p in set(excluded_scans))[:5])
        records.append(record)
        print(json.dumps(record), flush=True)
assert (ROOT / REL).read_bytes() == current_bytes, 'Current source drift during measurement'
summary = dict(
    root=str(ROOT), baseline_revision=BASE,
    invocation=[sys.executable, str(Path(__file__).resolve())],
    baseline_read_argv=argv, baseline_read_returncode=proc.returncode,
    baseline_read_stderr=proc.stderr.decode('utf-8', errors='replace'),
    baseline_source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(baseline_bytes).hexdigest(),
    current_source_sha256=hashlib.sha256(current_bytes).hexdigest(),
    membership_sha256=hashlib.sha256('\n'.join(expected).encode('utf-8')).hexdigest(),
    exact_sorted_membership_equal=True,
    source_unchanged_during_measurement=True,
    scope='Discovery only; os.scandir instrumented; excludes imports and AST analysis; one shared live target tree; five alternating-order pairs',
    baseline_median_seconds=statistics.median(r['elapsed_seconds'] for r in records if r['kind']=='baseline'),
    current_median_seconds=statistics.median(r['elapsed_seconds'] for r in records if r['kind']=='current'),
    records=records,
)
OUT.write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2), encoding='utf-8')
